summary: Turn facility bills, meter readings, and building data into energy actions. Explore the five-day course and its practical curriculum.
lede: Data analytics for energy management helps facility and energy professionals turn bills, meter readings and building-system data into operating decisions. Training covers reconciling bills with meter records, checking data quality, mapping significant energy uses, and selecting performance indicators to investigate operating patterns and prioritize actions.
audienceIntro: This foundation course is designed for professionals who work with building, facility, or site energy data and need to turn it into operational findings.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with utility bills, building or facility operations, or energy-consuming equipment is useful. No coding or programming is required. You should be comfortable with basic spreadsheet tasks such as entering data, sorting rows, and creating simple charts.
